en.headline: Customs seize controlled slimming injections and drugs worth HK$23 million, arrest seven
en.dek: Officers found the items in air parcels from Japan declared as ballpoint pens and in a city warehouse, with the drugs lacking local registration numbers.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Tuesday it had broken six air-parcel smuggling cases and raided a warehouse, seizing about 650,000 suspected controlled pharmaceutical products and finished tobacco products estimated at HK$23 million, and arrested seven people.

Airport officers selected six parcels from Japan declared as containing ballpoint pens. X-ray checks showed injection-shaped items, and inspection yielded 64 suspected controlled slimming injections valued at about HK$43,000. Six recipients aged 19 to 55 were arrested.

A further search of a warehouse linked to a suspicious parcel uncovered the bulk of the items, including suspected aphrodisiacs, fertility drugs and cancer medicines, leading to the arrest of a 40-year-old man believed to be in charge of the store.

Customs noted the seized products carried no Hong Kong registration numbers and that the injections had not been properly refrigerated, raising questions about their safety and quality. The seven arrested have been released on bail pending further investigation.

zh.headline: 海關檢獲市值約2300萬元受管制減肥針劑及藥物 拘捕7人
zh.dek: 人員在日本空運郵包（報稱原子筆）及市區倉庫檢獲物品，涉事藥物無本港註冊編號。
body: 香港海關周二公布，偵破六宗空運郵包走私案件，並搞破一個儲存走私受管制藥物的倉庫，檢獲約65萬件懷疑受管制藥物及製成菸草，估計總市值約2300萬元，共拘捕7人。
機場人員透過風險評估揀選六包由日本寄港、報稱載有原子筆的郵包。X光顯示針劑形狀物品，開箱後檢獲64支懷疑含第一部毒藥的受管制減肥針劑，市值約4.3萬元，並拘捕六名19至55歲收貨人。
人員再追查一個可疑郵包至市區倉庫，發現大批壯陽藥、治療不孕及癌症藥物等，拘捕一名40歲男子，相信是倉庫負責人。
海關指檢獲藥物包裝及標籤無本港衛生署註冊編號，減肥針劑亦無適當冷藏，安全品質存疑。七名被捕人已獲准保釋候查。
